name: Add a trip manually updates days used

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add) to open the trip sheet
Enter entry date 2026-09-01 and exit date 2026-09-10 in the trip form (data-testid=trip-form)
A trip row (data-testid=trip-row) for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-10 appears in the trip list
The status panel (data-testid=status-panel) shows 10 days used
